description: Hydrate an exact production location record by stable findtime id returned from search_timezones. Do not invent ids. If search_timezones has not been called, call it first.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

id.description: Stable location id. Current records use findtime:slug|CC|geonameId-or-state|TZ. Older findtime:slug|CC|TZ ids still resolve to the original city.

name: get_location_by_id
